title: 不管, 如果 or 即使?

means.不管: 不管…都…: no matter which, who or how; the result is the same. It needs a question form or a choice after it.
means.如果: 如果…就…: if this happens, then that.
means.即使: 即使…也…: even if this happens, that still holds.

items.zh: [不管]你去不去，我都去。
items.en: Whether you go or not, I'm going.
items.why: A choice (去不去) + 都: 不管.

items.zh: [如果]明天下雨，我们就不去了。
items.en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.
items.why: A plain condition + 就: 如果.

items.zh: [即使]明天下雨，我们也要去。
items.en: Even if it rains tomorrow, we'll still go.
items.why: Even if + 也: 即使.

items.zh: [不管]多忙，他每天都运动。
items.en: No matter how busy he is, he exercises every day.
items.why: 多忙 'how busy' + 都: 不管.

items.zh: [如果]你有时间，就来我家玩吧。
items.en: If you have time, come over to my place.
items.why: If + 就: 如果.

items.zh: [即使]你不说，我也知道。
items.en: Even if you don't tell me, I know.
items.why: Even if + 也: 即使.

items.zh: [不管]谁来，都要先打电话。
items.en: Whoever comes has to phone first.
items.why: 谁 'who' + 都: 不管.

items.zh: [如果]我是你，我就不买。
items.en: If I were you, I wouldn't buy it.
items.why: If + 就: 如果.

items.zh: [即使]再累，他也要把工作做完。
items.en: However tired he is, he'll finish the work.
items.why: Even if + 也: 即使.

title: 然后, 而且 or 然而?

means.然后: 然后 is 'then, after that': the next step in time.
means.而且: 而且 is 'and also, what's more': it adds a second point in the same direction.
means.然而: 然而 is 'however': what follows goes against what came before. It sounds written.

items.zh: 我们先吃饭，[然后]去看电影。
items.en: Let's eat first, then go to the cinema.
items.why: The next step in time: 然后.

items.zh: 这家店的菜很好吃，[而且]很便宜。
items.en: The food here is tasty, and it's cheap too.
items.why: A second good point: 而且.

items.zh: 他很努力，[然而]还是没有成功。
items.en: He worked hard; however, he still didn't succeed.
items.why: The opposite of what you'd expect: 然而.

items.zh: 他会说汉语，[而且]说得很好。
items.en: He speaks Chinese, and speaks it very well.
items.why: Adding a stronger point: 而且.

items.zh: 我先洗了个澡，[然后]就睡了。
items.en: I had a shower first and then went to sleep.
items.why: The next step: 然后.

items.zh: 大家都以为他会来，[然而]他没来。
items.en: Everyone thought he would come. However, he didn't.
items.why: Against what was expected: 然而.

items.zh: 这个房间很大，[而且]很安静。
items.en: This room is big, and it's quiet as well.
items.why: One more good point: 而且.

items.zh: 你下了车往右走，[然后]就能看到银行了。
items.en: Get off the bus and turn right, then you'll see the bank.
items.why: The next step: 然后.

items.zh: 这个办法听起来不错，[然而]做起来很难。
items.en: The idea sounds good. In practice, however, it's hard.
items.why: Turning against what came before: 然而.

means.既然: 既然 is 'since, now that': the first part is already a fact.
means.要是: 要是 is 'if': the first part may or may not happen.

items.zh: [既然]你已经决定了，我就不说什么了。
items.en: Since you've already decided, I won't say anything.
items.why: It is already a fact (已经): 既然.

items.zh: [要是]明天下雨，我们就不去了。
items.en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.
items.why: It may or may not happen: 要是.

items.zh: [既然]来了，就多坐一会儿吧。
items.en: Since you're here, stay a bit longer.
items.why: You are already here: 既然.

items.zh: [要是]明天你不舒服，就别来了。
items.en: If you don't feel well tomorrow, don't come.
items.why: Maybe, maybe not: 要是.

items.zh: [既然]你不喜欢，为什么还要买？
items.en: Since you don't like it, why buy it?
items.why: A known fact: 既然.

items.zh: [要是]我有钱，我就去旅游。
items.en: If I had money, I'd go travelling.
items.why: Not true now, just imagined: 要是.

items.zh: [既然]大家都同意，那就这么办吧。
items.en: Since everyone agrees, let's do it this way.
items.why: Already a fact: 既然.

items.zh: [要是]有问题，就给我打电话。
items.en: If there's a problem, give me a call.
items.why: Only if it happens: 要是.
